items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Willard was building the Benny Goodman band with Gene Krupa and Lionel Hampton.

ctx.x: time all the very great people who so justly deserve to be mentioned. In doing this we've left out one of the most financially successful and certainly one of the great innovators of jazz drumming. It's just an oversight on my part because we know him as a big band leader. We just forget to mention Lionel Hampton. the great Hump?
Let's leave him with his telephones. Lionel Hampton sit down there with them telephones, those vibraphones. That's it. Telephones. H: Is that what you call them? Jones': Telephones.
I remember back in Chicago, we played in Chicago in the Defender band together. I've seen him come a long ways and I thought maybe we could -
